description: Vodovodno omrežje - ATOM spletna storitev prenosa podatkov is a dataset listed in INSPIRE Metadata System Slovenia, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by eprostor.gov.si. Its keywords include infoFeatureAccessService. The listing shows 2021-12-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-metadata-si.
